notes: Shipping: the Ship page shows To ship and Shipped together, with Reprint label and Refund on every shipped row. One weight box with an oz or lb switch, and the declared value is optional. The Ship order page is one full-width step at a time, Ship to, Package, Rates, Buy, in bigger type, and the street address fills itself in as you type once the Google key is set. The Ship to step on an order is the order's customer: a Username box that never touches the label and a Name box that prints, both saved back to the customer when you buy; the customer search stays on Ship something else. One Ship button from a Live Desk paid bag and from a paid order on Orders straight to the Ship page. Copy on the tracking number on the Live Desk Paid tab, the customer's order history, the ship-together sibling line and the Orders row. Live Desk: Reopen on any closed session in the history list puts it back on the desk to add bags and cards; paid bags stay paid. Fix: a paid bag shows on Orders, the To ship list and the Paid tab the moment you mark it paid, and a customer made during a session shows up right away instead of after the next window refresh.
